description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarAccountRepository class, which provides methods for querying, retrieving, and managing calendar account data within the SuiteCRM application, particularly for the CalendarSync module. It contains methods for fetching validated accounts, checking for personal account existence, retrieving accounts by external ID, and applying various filtering criteria.

classes.name: CalendarAccountRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing data access and retrieval functions for calendar accounts within the CalendarSync module.

methods.name: getValidatedAccountsBatch
methods.description: Retrieves all validated calendar accounts in an optimized batch query, optionally limited in number.

methods.name: hasPersonalCalendarAccount
methods.description: Checks if a specific user has a personal calendar account.

methods.name: getPersonalCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all personal calendar accounts for a specific user.

methods.name: getValidatedPersonalCalendarAccountForUser
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent validated personal calendar account for a user.

methods.name: getAllValidatedCalendarAccountsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all validated calendar accounts associated with a user.

methods.name: findByExternalCalendarId
methods.description: Finds a calendar account by external calendar ID, excluding a specific account ID if provided.

methods.name: getCalendarAccountsForUser
methods.description: Base method to retrieve calendar accounts with flexible filtering options (by user ID, type, validation status, deletion status).
